# Köphumör på börsen – analytikern om serieförvärvarna

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon on Black Friday opened with Lannebo allocation chief Peter Lagerström Daglöf feeling fairly positive. He is overweight equities. He says there is more to markets than AI: electrification and defence are also driving themes. Swedish banks have beaten Nasdaq over five years, but he is trimming them slightly for next year. He also calls Swedish real estate a 'Black Friday sale' at about a 30% discount to NAV, with lower rates as the possible trigger. Handelsbanken analyst Sino Engdahlen Rissutti discussed the wave of serial-acquirer IPOs and named Lagercrantz as his top pick. The morning news included Prisjakt's first report with margin pressure, We Sport's acquisition of HSNG from Orkla, a weaker consumer confidence reading from Konjunkturinstitutet, DNB Carnegie upgrading Essity to buy and Barclays starting Securitas at underweight.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 LAGR-B — Lagercrantz | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Handelsbanken analyst's top serial-acquirer pick: under-rewarded performance, mid-single-digit organic growth, margin from 18% towards a 20% target.

#### Reasoning

The guest analyst (Handelsbanken) says the share hasn't been paid for its strong execution. He expects mid-single-digit organic growth and margin expansion from 18% to the 20% target, about half of it organic, plus a well-run acquisition machine. He thinks the combination makes the current valuation attractive. This is cited analyst opinion, not the host's.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth falls below mid-single digits
- if margin progress towards 20% stalls
- if acquisition execution weakens

> *"Den som jag kanske gillar mest är Lagercrantz."*

---

### 🟢 ESSITY-B — Essity | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

DNB Carnegie upgrades to buy from hold; the thesis depends on divesting consumer tissue, enabling faster acquisitions and buybacks.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited broker upgrade (DNB Carnegie, hold to buy), not the hosts' own view. The case depends on Essity spinning off or selling its consumer tissue unit, which could speed up acquisitions and share buybacks. The hosts point out it is conditional: 'we'll see if they succeed'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the consumer tissue divestment fails or is delayed
- if the proceeds are not used for acquisitions or buybacks

> *"Vill också nämna att en del av den analysen hänger på att man ska lyckas avknoppa eller avyttra konsumer tissue"*

---

### ⛔ SECU-B — Securitas | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Barclays starts coverage at underweight; shares fell about 1%.

#### Reasoning

This is cited analyst opinion only: Barclays started coverage with an underweight rating. The episode gives no further reasoning and the hosts add no view of their own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if other brokers upgrade
- if earnings beat expectations

> *"Där har Barclays inlett bevakning med rekommendationen undervikt."*
